column3: “Destroyers” supplies the noun for the four kinds.
Mothers and young men are plural instead of a mother of a young man.
Interceding with the enemy replaces making the enemy plead with the addressee.
“Anyone” replaces iron as the possible breaker.
Enslaving you to enemies replaces making your enemies pass over.
The second “words” is plural instead of singular.
“Mirage” and absent water interpret the image of an unreliable stream.
Speaking noble words specifies bringing the precious out of the worthless; “spokesman” resolves My mouth.
